title: Haprion API shared definitions
description: Every field of an API answer says in its description what kind it is. Code: a stable enumeration or identifier, safe to match on. Text: the page's own words, which may be reworded at any time; show it, never match on it. Value: a name, number, time, address or flag whose meaning and format are fixed.

state.description: Text. The dashboard's word for the node, such as Online or Behind. Match on tone, holds_vip and on_published_version instead.

tone.description: Code. The colour the dashboard gives the node: healthy, warning, critical or unknown.

detail.description: Text. The sentence under the node's state.

holds_vip.description: Value. True for the node that owns the address, false for a standby, null where the node was not read or never deployed.

release_version.description: Value. The published version the node reports it runs; null where it did not say.

on_published_version.description: Value. Whether the node runs the published version; null where it did not say.

haproxy_version.description: Value. The HAProxy version the node reports; null where it did not say.

node_package_version.description: Value. The haprion-node version installed on the node; null where it did not say.

kind.description: Code. What kind of fault the row reports.

cluster.description: Value. The cluster the row belongs to; null for a row that belongs to the installation.

subject.description: Text. What the row is about, as the dashboard names it: a node, a certificate, a link between two.

message.description: Text. The sentence the dashboard shows.

since.description: Value. When the fault was first seen; null where that is not known.

variant.description: Text. What tells this row from the same row made worse; an acknowledgement names it. Compare it for equality, do not interpret it.

status.description: The cluster's verdict as the dashboard card gives it.

label.description: Text. The card's word for the cluster, such as Healthy or Behind.

tone.description: Code. healthy, warning, critical or unknown.

detail.description: Text. The sentence under the card's word.

fresh.description: Value. Whether the reading is recent (within two polls); false means last known, not now.

observed_at.description: Value. When the nodes were last read; null for a cluster never read.

published_version.description: Value. The published version number; null where nothing is published or it is unknown.

release_state.description: Code. converged: every node runs the published version. behind: some node does not. incomplete: a node could not be read. unknown: nothing is published or no node said.

vip_holder.description: Value. The node that owns the address; null where none or more than one does, or it is unknown.

vip_count.description: Value. How many addresses the cluster keeps.

attention.description: The dashboard's Needs attention rows for this cluster.

managed.description: Value. False for a proxy the platform did not write.

protocol.description: Code. The object's protocol; null for a draft or a pending removal; unknown for a proxy the platform did not write and could not classify.

state.description: Code. serving: the nodes serve it. inactive: stored, not served yet. reconfigured: served, the nodes await the newest release. unreadable: the stored document cannot be read. include_missing: a syslog object whose forwarding is not set. disabled: an unmanaged proxy that is off. draft: edited, not stored yet. removal_pending: a published removal the nodes have not taken.

serving.description: Value. Whether the nodes serve the object; null for a draft or a pending removal.

readable.description: Value. Whether the stored document can be read; null for a draft, a pending removal or a proxy the platform did not write.

problem.description: Text. The engine's sentence on an unreadable object; given to a write token only, null otherwise.

hostnames.description: Value. The names the object answers to.

ports.description: Value. The ports the object listens on.

servers.description: Text. A tcp, dns or syslog object's servers as the Proxies page writes them; empty for the other protocols.

backend_count.description: Value. How many backends the object has; null where that is not known.

redirect_http.description: Value. Whether an https object redirects plain http; null for the other protocols.

vip.description: The address the object is served on; null where it is not known.

name.description: Value. The address's name in the cluster.

address.description: Value. The address; null where the engine did not give it.

is_default.description: Value. True where the object names none and the cluster's default is used.

source_address.description: Value. The address the object's requests to its servers leave from; null where none is set.

health.description: The object's servers rolled up to one lamp, as the Proxies page draws it; null where there is none.

tone.description: Code. healthy, warning, critical or unknown.

label.description: Text. The lamp's word, such as 2/2 up. Use up and total.

detail.description: Text. The sentence under the lamp.

up.description: Value. Servers the nodes report up.

draft.description: Work on the object that is not released; null for a read token, which is shown no drafts.

stage.description: Code. draft: still being edited. saved: waiting for a publish.

removal.description: Value. True where the change removes the object.

replaces.description: Value. The object this one replaces when it is renamed; null otherwise.

updated_at.description: Value. When it was last changed.

publishing.description: The job that is publishing the object now; null where none is.

label.description: Text. The badge's word for the running job.

publish_refused.description: Code. The engine's error code for the object's newest publish when it was refused and changed nothing; null otherwise.

operation.description: Code. What the job does: the command it runs, such as deploy or cert_publish.

label.description: Text. The Jobs page's name for the operation, such as Deploy configuration. Match on operation instead.

cluster.description: Value. The cluster the job works on; null for a job that belongs to no cluster, such as a certificate publish.

state.description: Code. pending and running: not finished. done, partial, blocked, failed: how it ended. unknown: it ended and its answer cannot be trusted.

state_label.description: Text. The Jobs page's word for the state, such as Completed. Match on state instead.

outcome.description: Code. The outcome the job's answer reports; null while the job has no answer.

finished.description: Value. False while the job is pending or running.

held.description: Value. True where the job waits for an administrator to run or discard it, after a restart or a restore.

queued_at.description: Value. When the job was queued.

started_at.description: Value. When it started; null while pending.

finished_at.description: Value. When it ended; null while not finished.

actor.description: Value. Who queued it; null where nobody did from the interface.

subjects.description: Value. What the job works on, such as the certificates or nodes it names; may be empty.

error_code.description: Code. The engine's error code when the job failed or was refused; open-ended, as the commands' error codes are. null otherwise.

error_message.description: Text. The engine's sentence with the code; given to a write token only, null otherwise.
